changeSet.author: nexus-s9wav
changeSet.comment: nexus-s9wav (4lnn1 R1): nexus.partition_set_leaf_autovacuum sets the four autovacuum reloptions on one leaf of nexus.chunks, idempotently; nexus.partition_ensure_leaf (vectors-030-1) is redefined to call it for every leaf it creates under a nexus.chunks parent, so a new tenant's leaves and a new model's leaves carry them from creation. Function definitions only; no DDL on a table, no row DML.

changeSet.author: nexus-s9wav
changeSet.comment: nexus-s9wav (4lnn1 R1): self-heal. On every boot, every leaf of the nexus.chunks partition tree is passed to nexus.partition_set_leaf_autovacuum, so a leaf made before vectors-034-1 (the RDR-225 walk's), or one that lost a value, carries the four autovacuum reloptions again. A leaf that already carries them is counted already correct and never altered, whoever owns it. A leaf it cannot lock within 5 s (lock timeout, or a deadlock with a session that waits on this transaction) or does not own is skipped with a WARNING and left for the next boot. Finding no leaf at all is a WARNING (the Java post-migrate step, event chunks_leaf_autovacuum_checked, reports leaves=0 and every unset leaf at WARN). runAlways, so editing this body is checksum-safe; a body guard, not a MARK_RAN precondition (nexus-ixsxa).

rollback.sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT t.relid::regclass AS leaf FROM pg_partition_tree('nexus.chunks'::regclass) t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.relid WHERE t.level > 0 AND t.isleaf AND c.relkind = 'r' LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s RESET (autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor, autovacuum_vacuum_threshold, autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor, autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor)', r.leaf); END LOOP; END $$;
